jobs.name: Crypto Monitor - Daily Report
jobs.prompt: You are running the Crypto Monitor project. The daily pipeline just ran. Follow /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/AGENT.md and /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/USER_REQUIREMENTS.md exactly. Read /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/data/reports/report_latest.json and /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/data/news/news_latest.json. Generate these two files (NO HEADER, just content): /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/data/reports/news_summary.md (numbered list per AGENT.md) and /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/data/reports/market_summary.md (per SUMMARY_GUIDE.md). Then post a Discord-friendly summary into this channel. Use the discord.send tool, attach the PNG charts that exist in /opt/projects/crypto-monitor/data/reports/, follow section ordering and emoji headers from USER_REQUIREMENTS.md. Do not run publish_pipeline.sh or any other publish script. Post directly with the discord tool.
